# Crossing the adoption gap (M12)

Choose pilot participants directly on a twelve-person network. Step simultaneous utility decisions, add inter-group links, change standalone benefit, switching friction and one-way compatibility. Pilot commitment is explicit; uncommitted pilots may revert. Inspect each person’s next choice and compare a pinned plan.

New utility = personal benefit + coordination × [new-neighbour share + compatibility × old-neighbour share]; old utility = coordination × old-neighbour share. Switch only when the alternative exceeds current utility by more than friction. Fixed heterogeneity and exact topology are exposed in the app. No financial or empirical calibration. Tests exercise critical mass, reversals, timing and bridges.
